reviews.text: Excellent institute! I called her for an emergency, and she was able to help me. Gentle, professional, and kind. I highly recommend her!
The best for our beloved Cocker Spaniel Bulle

Top-notch grooming!

It was Umi's first time, our young Corgi, and the care and attention were so gentle and kind. I highly recommend them!

I took my dog ​​Stann to Nina Dog for the first time and met a kind, attentive, and meticulous woman who was above all very professional. My dog ​​came out perfectly calm and clean with a silky coat; I'm delighted and she's officially my favorite groomer.
A true expert for our little Ziggy. Very kind and professional with our long-haired cat, she knew how to put her at ease. We will be back.

Fanny, a little Ragdoll too lazy to groom herself, was treated by her overly long mane and hampered by gingivitis. Nina took care of her with great patience, managing to untangle the matted fur while preserving the little darling's elegant appearance. The owner's presence during the grooming session is a real bonus because, beyond the professional techniques that can be used to save time at home, the interaction is smooth, pleasant, and enriching. A big thank you!

Nina Dog is a very competent, available, and accommodating groomer. When Nina Dog was recommended to us, we entrusted her with our Spitz and were delighted with the result. We recommend her 100%. Thanks again to Dog.

First grooming session for Izy, our Cavalier King Charles Spaniel, and Nina was absolutely adorable! Gentle, very friendly, and kind to our old girl and to us! She took the time to cuddle her, to understand the dog's needs and any skin issues or other concerns. Izy looked a bit younger and, most importantly, seemed to enjoy the time spent with Nina. I highly recommend her!

First grooming session for Vega, our little Miniature American Shepherd, and Nina was absolutely adorable! Gentle, very friendly, and kind to her! She took the time to reassure her (because she was terrified of the high-velocity dryer) and completed the entire grooming session, pausing for kisses and cuddles!
I recommend her 1000%! I've already booked another appointment for three months from now! Thank you so much!

I was very disappointed with the telephone reception at this groomer's. I found the person on the other end of the line haughty and unfriendly. Furthermore, I was quoted €12 just to trim my dog's nails, which seems excessive. A little courtesy and more reasonable prices would be appreciated. I do not recommend them.
A very gentle and pleasant groomer, I highly recommend her. My cat came out looking beautiful.
You are a very kind person with a genuine love for animals. My cat felt completely at ease with you; your movements were gentle, sure, and very professional. Thank you! 😀 …
